💡 The novelty lies in using LiO2 thermodynamics as a single unified descriptor linking ORR and OER bifunctional activity for dual-atom catalysts in aprotic Li-O2 batteries. item.title: Localized Bond Polarization Stabilizes Site-Selective Zn Intercalation in Orthorhombic Nb2O5
item.description:

Nano Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study provides the first atomic-scale evidence that Zn2+ occupies specific 4g interlayer sites in orthorhombic Nb2O5, revealing that site stability arises from localized Zn–O bond polarization coupled to Nb-centered charge compensation rather than geometry alone. This establishes electronic-structure design principles for multivalent-ion hosts and high-rate Zn storage materials.
